title: Wild and Wilful

vibeProfile.oneLine: Fifteen iconic Indian species, their lives and the fight to save them.

summary: Neha Sinha profiles fifteen iconic Indian species, from tigers and elephants to leopards, rhinos and migratory birds, blending natural history, field encounters and the urgent politics of conservation. A wildlife scientist and writer, she shows how these animals live, why they matter, and how they collide with a fast-changing, crowded country. Engaging and heartfelt, it makes the case for coexistence and brings India's threatened wildlife vividly to life for the general reader.
whyReadIt: Fifteen of India's iconic species brought to life by a wildlife scientist, with the politics of saving them. Warm and urgent.

funFacts.text: Neha Sinha is a conservation scientist as well as a nature writer.
